name: Root
description: Thin orchestration layer for the exemplar.tools documentation website. Composes child modules (project_scaffold, routing_and_layout, page_content) to wire all 13 page components into a router and mount the React application into the DOM. Owns no domain types — all canonical types are defined by child modules. Consists of two files: src/root.ts (exports initApp) and src/main.tsx (side-effect entry point that calls initApp, no exports).

types.name: void
types.description: TypeScript void return type, indicating the function returns no value.

types.name: RouterInstance
types.description: Opaque React Router browser router instance returned by createBrowserRouter / createAppRouter. Passed to RouterProvider for mounting.

types.name: ReactElement
types.description: React.ReactElement / JSX.Element returned by React functional components.

functions.name: initApp
functions.description: Composition entry point that wires all child modules together and mounts the application. Imports createAppRouter from routing_and_layout (which internally references all 13 page components from page_content via ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST and the Layout/Sidebar shell). Calls createAppRouter() to build the complete route tree with all 13 routes (home + 12 steps). Then calls mountApp from project_scaffold, which creates a React root on the #root DOM element and renders the application with the router. This function is the single point of integration — it ensures that routing_and_layout's createAppRouter has already wired every page component to its route, so root merely invokes the composition. File: src/root.ts.

functions.name: main
functions.description: Side-effect entry point module at src/main.tsx. Imports initApp from src/root.ts and calls it immediately. Also imports src/index.css for Tailwind style injection. This module has zero named exports — it is referenced by index.html as <script type='module' src='/src/main.tsx'> and executes on load. This is not a callable function but a module-level side effect.

invariants: Root owns zero domain types — all types (StepId, StepLabel, RouteSlug, StepContent, RouteEntry, etc.) are defined by and imported from child modules.
Root does not re-export any child module types or constants — consumers import directly from the owning child module.
The total number of registered routes is exactly 13: 1 home route + 12 step routes.
src/main.tsx has zero named exports — it is a side-effect-only entry point.
src/root.ts exports exactly one named runtime export: initApp.
initApp calls createAppRouter exactly once and mountApp exactly once, in that order.
Root has no direct runtime dependency on shared_ui or pipeline_diagram — those are consumed transitively through page_content and routing_and_layout.
All slug handling is delegated to ensureLeadingSlash from routing_and_layout — root never manipulates slug strings directly.
All source files use TypeScript strict mode, named exports only, and 'export type { }' for type-only exports per project standards.

data_access.rationale: Root is a pure orchestration layer that reads no persistent data and writes no persistent data. It composes child modules (routing configuration, page components, scaffold utilities) at application startup. All data access is transitive through child modules. The only state mutation is the one-time DOM mount of the React application tree into the #root element, which is an in-memory browser DOM operation with no data classification implications.

side_effects.rationale: Mounts the React application tree into the #root DOM element at startup. This is a public, client-side browser DOM operation with no sensitive data.
